notes: The repository-level main-protection ruleset is the canonical enforcement mechanism for main.
The required quality (24) context is a deterministic aggregator over repository-owned quality, tests/coverage, extension integrity, package/docs/Docker, and supported-OS matrix jobs.
Codecov remains advisory coverage telemetry; local Vitest thresholds and report validation are the blocking coverage authority.
The repository-owned semgrep job is required so project-specific security rules are enforced before merge.
SonarQube Cloud remains enabled with GitHub App automatic analysis but is advisory rather than required.
The ruleset has no bypass actors and required status checks use strict/up-to-date enforcement.
